question: As on July 2023, Deepika Deshwal is the youngest Indian to deliver a speech at the _______ for the third time.
solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As on **July 2023**, **Deepika Deshwal** is the youngest Indian to deliver a speech at the **United Nations** for the third time.
 
• The United Nations is an international organization founded in **1945 **and currently made up of **193 Member States**.
 
• The mission and work of the United Nations are guided by the purposes and principles contained in its founding Charter.
 
• Deepika Deshwal's speeches have focused on various global issues, including climate change, gender equality, and education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **United Nations General Assembly** (UNGA) is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations, where all member nations have equal representation.
 
• The UNGA **meets once a year** in a regular session starting in September and can also meet in special and emergency special sessions.
 
• Deepika's involvement at the United Nations highlights the growing role of youth in international discourse and decision-making processes.
